== English Special Edition comparison ==
The printed card names Emperor Palpatine in both text bands. Decipher's Glossary Supplement replaces the name with Emperor on both sides. The physical scan shows both uniqueness dots. The 2013 and 2017 slip and later Players Committee renders repeat the Decipher game text.
